topic: University student protests against a new student debt and fee payment protocol at Rhodes University (Makhanda)
scale: Campus shutdown from 2026-09-29; about 100 students demonstrated outside the spring graduation on 2026-10-02; 13 students, aged 19-23, arrested
quote1: Police said the students, aged between 19 and 23, were arrested for allegedly contravening a court order.
quote2: A court interdict against protests at Rhodes University did not stop about 100 students from demonstrating outside a graduation ceremony on Friday morning.
